author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Is buying a tool kit a better starting point than buying tools individually at the start of a project? How does Adam Savage decide when it’s time to acquire or replace a tool? In this live stream excerpt Adam answers these questions from Tested members J-Sanderson and Patrick Hennessy, whom we thank for their support! How do you acquire the tools YOU need of things?
